name: convergence-classify
description: Calibration harness orchestration: routes a loop-iteration trajectory through judge-convergence and emits the CHOSEN decision as its output (each branch is a code node returning its own name). That makes the judge eval-able — an eval with an `exact` scorer measures how accurately it stops loops that are done/oscillating/stalled and continues loops making real progress. Pair with datasets/convergence-calibration.json + evals/convergence-calibration.json.
